purpose: Separate frozen self-target correctness from question-target correspondence, not direct internal belief consistency.
allocation_scorer: scoring_v2 floor, all Answer aliases; legacy and truncate rescoring sensitivity
subset_note: Wrong and correct subsets fixed across train seeds; within-category sample min(n_correct,n_wrong). Correct-vs-wrong questions differ.
shuffle_note: Wrong-only donor permutation, same category, different person, different literal target, recipient still wrong; exact per-category target multiset preserved. Randomized bipartite matching, not uniform permutation sampling.
gold_usage: Gold determines correctness strata and constrains permutation; gold never replaces production training targets. This is a supervised mechanism diagnostic.
primary_tests: 18 C composed McNemar tests Holm-adjusted: 9 against base, 9 between conditions. C hop declines: separate family of 18 Holm-adjusted tests. Per-seed values retained.
seed_summary: Mean, sample SD (ddof=1), paired three-seed difference and Student-t95 df2. Repeated evaluation items never pooled as independent seeds.
limitations: Uncertain/missing aliases and legacy text scoring can misclassify semantic correctness. Labels are scorer-defined, not human-adjudicated truth.
Correct and wrong groups are category-matched but not question/difficulty/person-matched.
Changed-and-still-wrong constraint conditions the shuffled distribution.
Floor/truncate sensitivity rescoring does not redo training allocation.
No equivalence/noninferiority margin; nonsignificance does not establish no forgetting.
